newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's CVRD surges on high court ruling.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's CVRD surges on high court ruling.

text.p: Shares of state mining giant Cia Vale do Rio Doce surged after Brazil's high court tossed out a legal challange to the firm's planned April 29 privatization, brokers said.
CVRD's blue-chip preferred stock was up 3.3 percent at 26.60 reais while its common voting stock was flat at 29.90 reais by 1555 local/1455 EDT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
"The market was focused on this issue, so when the decision came out, it shot up," a local broker told Reuters.

The rise in CVRD pushed the wider bolsa higher. The bourse's Bovespa index of 49 most-traded shares was up 1.45 percent at 9,608 points on trade of nearly $450 million, about 10 percent of which was in CVRD stock.

CVRD's preferred share was already up on the day but jumped more than two and a half percentage points after the Supreme Federal Tribunal (STF) threw out a constitutional challange to the selloff by Brazil's Organization of Brazilian Attorneys (OAB).
